scope: Prospective hypothesis after active t5. No active production artifacts, data rows, predictions, labels, API ledgers or new metrics were read; no fits, API calls or tests were launched. Frozen sources were not changed.

actual_context_contract.cold_start: data_summary.class_counts contains full train.csv row counts, duplicate_feature_rate and features. split contains train_rows, validation_rows, split_sha256, shared_feature_hashes and validation_class_counts. feedback_read_first is empty before fitting.
actual_context_contract.later_feedback: Last 12 worker records provide status, scalar metric, per_class_f1, recipe parameters, error and wall_seconds; no explicit independent fitting groups or anchor-relative class deltas are added.
missing: Explicit per-class raw fitting row counts, separated from full input rows and validation rows
Unique raw-feature-hash groups per class restricted to this split's fitting indices
Identification of support-limited classes and an explanation that duplicate rows do not supply independent support
Measured per-class deltas against the preserved same-split control, and a diagnostic aggregate excluding the rarest class
Explicit warning when a scalar gain comes entirely from the rarest class while independently supported classes worsen
actual_context_contract.existing_but_not_wired: automl.error_analysis.classification.describe computes independent_fitting_groups_per_class, but search.runner does not import/call that diagnostic or add its output to planner_context. make_split computes groups_per_class internally for splitter selection, but does not return per-class fitting support.

prior_saved_evidence.scope: Historical reused-public primary cut only; not a claim about current t5 outcomes or private/official score.

historical_failure_example.interpretation: Aggregate gain alone hid losses on three classes with at least 100 independent fitting groups. This candidate was deterministic fallback, not a Qwen proposal; this evidence motivates better context, not attribution of failure to Qwen.

minimal_next_prospective_change.factor: Add one bounded typed class_support object to classification planner context, including cold-start support and later same-split protected-control-relative diagnostics.
minimal_next_prospective_change.implementation_scope: Compute counts from existing in-memory raw feature hashes and fitting indices, before transformations/resampling; do not load another train table. Add only small aggregate maps, no example rows. Derive later deltas from already completed current-run same-split control/candidate metrics; leave null until both exist. No outer/confirmation feedback in proposal selection. Keep Macro F1 objective, protected control, sampler, recipes and evaluator unchanged.
minimal_next_prospective_change.new_mechanism: Failure-aware context explicitly relates observed scalar improvements to support and protected-control losses. Merely repeating the earlier support-count-only prompt is not justified: its old component screen failed strict gates.
minimal_next_prospective_change.instruction: Distinguish full rows from independent fitting support. Treat rarest-class gains as uncertain; name supported-class losses when proposing the next bounded ablation. A support threshold is a diagnostic convention, not proof of statistical significance or a replacement objective.

matched_evaluation_plan.first_stage: One matched bounded proposal pair from exactly the same saved current-run context after completion: original versus augmented class_support only. Hold model, reasoning, prompt outside this object, token/call/candidate caps, arm order declaration and generation timeout fixed. Record validity/novelty, token/time cost and the changed factor; generation is not a quality gain.
matched_evaluation_plan.component_stage: Predeclare novel single-factor recipes and matched preserved control; run both on the same immutable primary and confirmation cuts, same seeds and runtime caps. Recompute metrics independently only after jobs finish. Report Macro F1, per-class deltas, ex-rarest diagnostic, failures and runtime. Do not promote from a single stochastic generation pair.
matched_evaluation_plan.whole_agent_stage: If components warrant it, compare the complete agent with and without this context factor under equal total common budgets, controls, splits, planner/HPO/refit/export caps; retain all timeout/invalid outcomes and require CSV, integrity, source and unpacked gates. Do not modify or rerun active t5 for this hypothesis.
uncertainties: The same model may ignore added support or change proposals stochastically
The old rarest support of 46 is split-specific and must be measured for each prospective fitting cut
Repeated public-cut feedback may overfit; confirmation remains evaluation-only
Extra context can consume tokens/time and reduce completed useful trials
No improvement or official score is established by this note
